boundary_observations.cline_peculiarity_resource_loader_absent: ClineMM does NOT implement the upstream three-level progressive-disclosure model. There is no L3 'resource' loader. The entire SKILL.md body - including any paths to scripts/docs/etc. - is delivered as instructions text. SW-CM03's resource-minimality assertions therefore target (a) literal-text reference presence (the model can see the path), and (b) absence of inlined resource contents (no eager load). Per-resource loading is the model's responsibility via generic file tools - scope-defers to model-evals, deferred per Section 20.
boundary_observations.alias_canonicalization_observed_in_child: Section D2 (configured-agent skills: [review] -> child skills tool) demonstrates the same SW-CM02 B5 invariant: skill allowlist is honored end-to-end at the child runtime. No alias canonicalization is needed because child sees only 'skills' as the executor name.
boundary_observations.id_normalization_lowercases_via_unified_: Section C4 confirms POSTGRES-OPERATIONS resolves to the same skill as postgres-operations. This matches the upstream open issue's intent: skill lookup is case-insensitive at the watcher resolution layer.

notes: This ACT is the third leg of the SW-CM sequence. SW-CM01 measured trigger-side; SW-CM02 measured routing; SW-CM03 measures what flows back to the model after routing.

The configured-agent skill-scope observation in Section D uses the same vi.mock('./session-runtime-orchestrator') pattern as the SW-CM02 B4-B7 tests, but here the asserted property is the description-suffix of the CHILD's skills tool (filtered by the agent.skills allowlist) AND the captured child skills tool's execute() response for both known and unknown skill names - a uniform integration that exercises the same production child-construction seam for an additional surface.

ClineMM's peculiarity: the runtime exposes progressivity SIMPLER than upstream - there is no dedicated L3 'resource' loader in ClineMM. Skill bodies reference resource paths as literal text; loading each resource is the model's responsibility via generic file tools. The runtime does NOT inline resource contents into the guide payload - this is observable as the absence of any RESOURCE_MARKER lines in the returned XML (D6).
Model sufficiency (did the model pick the right resource to read?) is not in this ACT's purview. SW-CM03 is deterministic on disk fixtures and PASS does not require any provider invocation.
